manifest_version.description: Manifest file format version understood by BLESPloit.

manifest_version_note.description: Optional. Short label when bumping manifest_version (e.g. first manifest format); omit if not needed.

version.description: Pack content revision; bumped on edit and compared for ESP32 sync.

vars.description: Relative path to the Lua vars file (strings, numbers, and booleans). Firmware and the phone load this path.

vars_fields.description: Relative path to the phone vars-editor field file (labels, hints, ranges, and choices). Firmware does not load it. When omitted, the editor looks for vars_fields.json beside the vars file.

icon.description: Relative path to the scan/library icon (.svg or .png). PNG is not tinted; prefer a square 128–256 px image with alpha, preferably as small as possible

icon_tint.description: Optional SVG-only tint (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB). Ignored for PNG. Exposed as Lua assets.icon_tint and scan-row custom_icon_tint.

peripheral.description: Peripheral simulation on ESP32 and phone Local Sim. observe subscribes after advertising starts on ESP32, Android, and iOS.

observe.description: true matches every legacy advertisement and subscribes after advertising starts. An object seeds the filter from scan_conditions (company_id, manufacturer_data_prefix_hex, service_data_uuid_16, device_name_contains) before the script runs. Absent or false does not subscribe. Android and iOS Local Sim call on_adv. Phone reports are not a separate scan response. On iOS, addr is six octets from the peripheral UUID, not the Bluetooth address.

scanConditionStringOrStrings.description: A single string or an array of alternatives; if an array, any value may match (OR).

scanConditionIntOrInts.description: A single AD type byte (decimal or 0x hex) or an array of types; any may match with ad_type_data_hex.

fingerprintEntryAttributes.description: All key/value pairs must match attributes on the fingerprint entry whose id is in fingerprint_has_entry_id. Values are compared as strings.

one_of.description: OR over alternative condition groups. Together with the other properties on the same object: (all top-level property checks) AND (at least one one_of item must match, each item is ANDed internally; items may nest one_of).

company_id.description: Bluetooth SIG Company Identifier (16-bit). Prefer four hex digits (e.g. "0006", "05A7"); decimal integers and 0x-prefixed hex are also accepted.

allOf.description: Case-sensitive substring match on the advertised BLE device name (Complete/Short Local Name). OR across array values.

Kotlin regex on the advertised BLE device name. Uses containsMatchIn; anchor with ^ and $ for full-string match. Case-sensitive unless (?i) is used. Invalid patterns do not match. OR across array values.

centralFingerprintValueOrValues.description: Allowed fingerprint attribute value(s). OR across array values.

fingerprint.description: Per-key allowed fingerprint values. All keys must match (AND); each key ORs its allowed values.

services.description: GATT service UUIDs (16/32/128-bit) that must all be present on the connection.

require_discovered_services.description: When true (default) and services is non-empty, service UUID rules require a real GATT discovery snapshot on the Inspect sheet. Set false only to match optimistically before discovery.

fingerprint_or_services.description: When false (default), non-empty fingerprint and services must both match. When true, match if either branch matches.

hint.description: Optional display-only subtitle for a quick action or full menu. Not a match key. Omit when the title is enough. Distinct from a fingerprint hint, a vars_fields editor hint, and a menu item input spec.
